title: Chapter 255 Emperor Yuan'S Tribulation
content:
Chapter 255 Emperor Yuan'S Tribulation

Kill the Refining Heaven? !

The two of them were stunned for a moment, but then they quickly reacted.

Master Killing, Killing Refining Heaven.

It turns out that the full name of Master Shi on the stage is Shi Liantian.

This name is no ordinary person at first sounded.

"Qin Feng in Xiaxianyuan Tiandi Academy."

"Xiao Luo, Xiao clan in the Xiaxian Realm."

The two introduced themselves to Yuanyuan.

The three of them met here.

Whether it was Tiandi Academy or Xiao Clan, Yuanyuan had no reaction and just nodded slightly.

At this time, Lu Xue pointed to the platform below, Shi Liantian said, "Yuanyuan, why is your master different from Master Qiao?"

Since there is someone who knows what you know, Lu Xue naturally wants to ask for advice.

Qin Feng and the others beside them also nodded, "Yes, this alchemy technique has never been seen or heard of."

Upon hearing this, Yuanyuan also placed her gaze on her master below, and her expression unconsciously showed a hint of admiration, and the corners of her mouth slowly rose.

"This is Master's absolute confidence in the way of alchemy. Restoring pills can be refined even with his eyes closed, and the effect is not bad at all."

Yuanyuan said slowly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue and the other two suddenly looked slightly condensed.

Continuing to look at the Shi Liantian Pill, the few people gradually saw a clue.

Although it seems messy to refine pills in Shi Liantian, all the medicinal materials for refining pills will be arranged in an orderly manner after entering the pill furnace.

The black flame is extremely efficient.

All the medicinal materials will evaporate instantly and turn into the purest energy when they come into contact with the black flame.

The purification effect can only be seen by the real alchemy master present.

In the square, several famous alchemists in the fairyland were already sweating profusely at this moment, staring at Shi Liantian on the stage, not even daring to blink.

"Genius, no, evil spirit!"

"A elixir monster!"

"I have been practicing elixirs for ten thousand times. This is the first time I know that the elixir can still be refined like this."

A strong amazement arises from the bottom of his heart, and at the same time, a slightly admiring gaze slowly emerges from the unyielding eyes of several people.

Although no one can be called the top alchemist, there is a slight gap with Jordanyang.

But in their hearts, they never felt that they were far from Jordan.

Jordan Yang's achievements are so high, which is just luck.

But now, when they saw the Sword and Refining Heaven Pill, they were completely convinced.

It almost crushed them in all aspects.

A true alchemist can tell the difference at a glance even if he refines the most common elixirs.

Now, that's it!

It’s a pity that Jordanyang could not witness this feast.

Those in the authorities are confused, while those onlookers are clear.

At this moment, Jordan Yang was concentrating on refining the recovery pill, and he was not too distracted to see the opponents who were refining the pills.

This time, he decided to break the record again and refine pills that are better than the last time to restore the pills.

Try to make it effective if you take it in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Although Jordanyang showed sweat on his face, he was full of confidence.

Look, Jordan Yang is the only one in the top alchemy master in the Immortal Realm!

The alchemy competition in the square was like fire and tea, and there was also undercurrents in the dark.

Countless old monsters in the fairy world rose up and woke up from their sleep, rushing towards the direction of the deserted city of the Wood Fairy World.

It is no exaggeration to say that this alchemy competition located in the Wood Immortal Realm has almost involved the entire Immortal Realm.

Including the fairyland.

No famous and powerful Immortal Emperor realm powerhouse can refuse the elixirs of the alchemy master.

What's more, there are two!

Of course, there are exceptions.

Golden Immortal Realm.

Inside a pitch-black tower.

With the deafening buzzing sound, the entire tower began to tremble wildly.

Rumble!

At this moment, the void began to collapse.

The sound of the Tao was roaring, and countless powerful people in the Golden Immortal Realm looked in the direction of the Black Tower in horror.

The buzzing sound became louder and louder, and a terrifying and powerful aura gradually came from the black tower.

Seeing this scene, the horror in the eyes of the strong gradually turned into fanaticism.

"It's Emperor Yuan, it's Emperor Yuan!"

Emperor Yuan!

When Lu Dao came to the Wood Immortal Realm, he was the one who beat him!

Now, after many years, Emperor Yuan has finally broken through his limits and then established himself.

boom!

The black tower collapsed, and a majestic figure suddenly soared into the sky and flew straight into the void.

I saw that his black hair was dispersed, and the unruly face on his former face had long disappeared, but it was even more terrifying.

Emperor Yuan looked at the void with cold eyes.

Buzz —

Under the horrifying eyes of the world, a terrifying cloud of disaster slowly emerged from the void.

Directly pointing to Emperor Yuan!

Pass the tribulation!

The world was shocked again, but then, it started to roar wildly.

The Golden Immortal Realm has taken off.

A strong man above the Immortal Emperor Realm!

As the Golden Immortal World with the strongest overall strength in the five major immortal worlds, even if they do not enter the Immortal Realm, the strong people in the Golden Immortal World can still reach the peak of the terrifying Immortal Emperor Realm.

This is true for Emperor Yuan.

Although Emperor Yuan had entered the fairyland when he was young, Emperor Yuan finally attained enlightenment and became emperor in the Golden Immortal Realm and was well-known.

It is also famous on the list of Immortal Emperors in the center of the Immortal Realm.

Such a strong man can be called the pride of their Golden Immortal Realm.

And now, Emperor Yuan has made a breakthrough again.

I saw Emperor Yuan stepping on the void, stretching his arms, looking down at him, and shouting loudly: "I am the Immortal Emperor, why fear the heavenly tribulation!"

"Come on!"

An invincible momentum surged out from the body of Emperor Yuan, and the entire void was trembling wildly under the breath of Emperor Yuan.

And the terrifying catastrophe cloud also burst out with its supposed power with the roar of Emperor Yuan.

boom!

I saw a thunder tribulation as thick as a bucket fell straight from the calamity cloud and slashed on the Yuan Emperor's heavenly spirit cover.

With this attack, Emperor Yuan's body did not move at all, and he was forced to suffer the first thunder tribulation.

At this time, the entire Jinxian world cultivators stopped what was going on and stared at the Yuan Emperor in the void with a nervous expression to overcome the tribulation.

Once Emperor Yuan succeeds, their Golden Immortal Realm will not only increase their status in the entire Immortal Realm, but will also receive feedback from the Heavenly Way.

The Golden Immortal Realm will become stronger and stronger in the future.

Seeing Emperor Yuan easily take over the first thunder tribulation, the world smiled.

"The invincible posture of Emperor Yuan is not as good as that of the past."

It has to be said that Emperor Yuan was very arrogant in the face of the heavenly tribulation at this moment, but Emperor Yuan had this arrogant capital.

Apart from Lu Daosheng who suddenly appeared back then, he has never lost a game.

But Emperor Yuan had not yet shown any emotion, and what followed was the continuous devastating thunder catastrophe strikes of the heavenly tribulation.

Boom boom boom boom!

Several thunder tribulations struck down one after another.

The second, the third, the fourth,
